restaurants.name: Saravana Bhavan (Munnar)
restaurants.insider_tip: Go here for a reliable and quick vegetarian breakfast. The filter coffee is strong and authentic.

restaurants.name: Tea Valley Restaurant
restaurants.signature_dish: Malabar Fish Curry, Tandoori Chicken Platter
restaurants.insider_tip: Perched inside a resort on a tea hill, offering wide dining room windows looking out over misty valleys.

restaurants.name: The Tibetan Kitchen
restaurants.insider_tip: The outdoor garden tables are beautiful. The Gyakok pot requires ordering 4 hours in advance as it is slow-cooked.

restaurants.name: Chopsticks Noodle Bar
restaurants.insider_tip: A clean and modern restaurant on Fort Road. Sit on the balcony for a view of the street while dining.

restaurants.name: Gesmo Restaurant (German Bakery)
restaurants.signature_dish: Yak Cheese Pizza, Apple Pie, Yak Burgers
restaurants.insider_tip: Affectionately known as the traveler's hub in Leh. Try their fresh yak cheese pizzas and walnut pies.

restaurants.name: Britannia & Co. (Ballard Estate)
restaurants.signature_dish: Berry Pulav, Sali Boti, Caramel Custard
restaurants.insider_tip: They are open only for lunch (11 AM to 4 PM) and are closed on Sundays. Cash only.

restaurants.name: Bademiya (Colaba)
restaurants.insider_tip: A legendary open-air midnight eating street spot. Eat directly off your car bonnet for the true Mumbai experience.

restaurants.name: Shree Thaker Bhojanalay (Kalbadevi)
restaurants.insider_tip: Tucked away in the narrow lanes of Kalbadevi, this is widely considered the absolute best Gujarati Thali in India.

restaurants.name: Vidyarthi Bhavan (Gandhi Bazaar)
restaurants.insider_tip: Expect massive queues on weekends (wait times up to 1 hour). The crispy, ghee-soaked dosas are worth the wait.

restaurants.name: Mavalli Tiffin Room (MTR - Lalbagh)
restaurants.signature_dish: Rava Idli, Silver Cup Filter Coffee
restaurants.insider_tip: The birthplace of Rava Idli during WWII wheat shortages. The interior preserves a 1920s dining club feel.

restaurants.name: Karavalli (Gateway Hotel)
restaurants.insider_tip: Dine under a beautiful old tamarind canopy tree. A premium, award-winning venue showcasing coastal food.

restaurants.name: Peter Cat (Park Street)
restaurants.insider_tip: Famous for its unique Chelom kababs served with a dollop of butter and egg yolk on rice. Long queues are standard.

restaurants.name: 6 Ballygunge Place
restaurants.signature_dish: Kosha Mangsho (Mutton), Daab Chingri (Prawns in Coconut)
restaurants.insider_tip: Set inside a beautiful 100-year-old heritage bungalow. Opt for the buffet during festivals to sample 20+ local dishes.

restaurants.name: Arsalan (Park Circus)
restaurants.signature_dish: Kolkata Mutton Biryani (with Potato and Egg)
restaurants.insider_tip: Kolkata Biryani is famous for its slow-cooked soft potato. Arsalan is widely considered the king of this style.

restaurants.name: Trattoria (Police Bazar)
restaurants.signature_dish: Jadoh (Rice cooked in pork blood), Dohkhlieh
restaurants.insider_tip: A tiny, basic stall serving authentic Khasi tribal food. Not for the faint-hearted; try the pork salad.

restaurants.name: Cafe Shillong (Laitumkhrah)
restaurants.insider_tip: A cool hangout space featuring local musicians playing acoustic guitar. Great English breakfasts.

restaurants.name: City Hut Family Dhaba
restaurants.insider_tip: The most popular family restaurant in Shillong, featuring a nice indoor thatch courtyard layout.

restaurants.name: Cafe 1947 (Old Manali)
restaurants.signature_dish: Firewood Pizza, Trout Fish with Lemon Butter
restaurants.insider_tip: Manali's first music cafe, situated directly on the banks of the rushing Manalsu River. Great acoustic gig nights.

restaurants.name: Il Forno
restaurants.insider_tip: Set in an old rustic wooden house on a hill road, offering amazing views of snowy peaks from the garden tables.

restaurants.name: Johnson's Cafe
restaurants.insider_tip: Famous for its preparation of fresh local river trout. They have a lovely green lawn and a cozy indoor fireplace.

restaurants.name: Little Buddha Cafe
restaurants.insider_tip: Get there early around sunset; seats overlooking the river are highly popular and fill up fast.

restaurants.name: Beatrice Cafe
restaurants.insider_tip: Very popular with long-stay foreign backpackers. Relaxed, hippie ambiance.

restaurants.name: Freedom Cafe
restaurants.insider_tip: Great views of Lakshman Jhula bridge from their balcony cushions.

restaurants.name: Gushaini Village Dhaba
restaurants.signature_dish: Siddu with ghee, Local dal rice
restaurants.insider_tip: Simple, roadside wooden dhaba serving hot and fresh local food.
